optionalfeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: At 1st tier, and again at 2nd, 3rd, 4th, and 5th tier, you can increase one of your ship's ability scores by 2, or you can increase two of these ability scores by 1.

entries.name: Maximum Scores by Size
entries: You can't increase ability scores above the limit for your ship's size category:

items: {@b Tiny:} ability scores other than Dexterity above 20, or your Dexterity above 24, with this feature
{@b Small:} ability scores other than Dexterity above 20, or your Dexterity above 22, with this feature
{@b Medium:} ability scores above 20, with this feature
{@b Large:} ability scores other than Constitution above 20, or your Constitution above 22, with this feature
{@b Huge:} ability scores other than Constitution above 20, or your Constitution above 24, with this feature
{@b Gargantuan:} ability scores other than Constitution above 20, or your Constitution above 26, with this feature

entries.name: Tiny through Large
entries: Your ship gains 1 additional Hull Die and 1 additional shield Die. It gains 1 additional Hull Die and 1 additional shield Die at 2nd tier (2, each), 3rd tier (3, each), 4th tier (4, each), and 5th tier (5, each).

entries.name: Huge and Gargantuan
entries: Your ship gains 2 additional Hull Dice and 2 additional shield Dice. It gains 2 additional Hull Dice and 2 additional shield Dice at 2nd tier (4, each), 3rd tier (6, each), 4th tier (8, each), and 5th tier (10, each).

optionalfeature.name: Armor Class Improvement
entries: Beginning at second Tier, your ship's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-sotg|armor class} improves, giving your ship a +1 to its AC.  It gains an additional +1 bonus to AC at 3rd Tier (+2 total), 4th Tier (+3 total), and 5th Tier (+4 total).

optionalfeature.name: Superior Firepower

entries.name: Availability
entries: Gargantuan starship, tier 1
Also at 1st tier, your starship's firepower can overwhelm larger ships.

When a crewmember deals damage to a Large or larger ship with a ship weapon, the crewmember can increase the damage by rolling a Superior Firepower die, which is a {@dice d4}, and add it to the damage roll (no action required).
Your ship's Superior Firepower die changes when it reaches certain tiers. The die becomes a {@dice d6} at 2nd tier, a {@dice d8} at 3rd tier, a {@dice d10} at 4th tier, and a {@dice d12} at 5th tier.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to 3 x your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship undergoes recharging.

optionalfeature.name: Role Specialization (Gargantuan)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Gargantuan starship, tier 2
At 2nd tier, you adopt a particular style of design for your ship. Choose any one from the following.

entries.name: Blockade Ship
entries: Your ship gains the Emergency Generator and Power Backup modifications at no cost. Additionally, your ships shields extend further around it. Whenever a friendly ship would take damage while within 500 feet of your ship, if the source of that damage is more than 500 feet away from your ship and your ship's shields are active, your ship's shields instead take that damage. If the damage reduces your ship's shields to 0, the protected ship takes any remaining damage.

entries.name: Flag Ship
entries: Your ship gains the Command Center suite and Tractor Beam modifications at no cost. Additionally, when a crewmember deployed in a command center takes the Direct action, the target of the Direct action can reroll one of the dice once.

entries.name: Industrial Center
entries: Your ship gains two Workshop modifications at no cost.  Additionally, the {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} at which goods are crafted in your workshops is doubled.

entries.name: Mobile Metropolis
entries: Your ship gains a Living Quarters suite and a Recreation suite at no cost. Additionally, the capacity of your Living Quarters are doubled.

entries.name: Researcher
entries: Your ship gains the Laboratory and Workshop modifications at no cost. Additionally, Intelligence ({@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}) checks on your ship are made with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage}.

entries.name: Warship
entries: Your ship gains two Fixed Hardpoint modifications at no cost. Additionally, your ship has a +1 bonus to damage rolls with ship weapons.

optionalfeature.name: Prime Doctrine

entries.name: Availability
entries: Gargantuan starship, tier 2

Also at 2nd tier, your starship strikes fear in your enemies. When crewmembers roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}, one crewmember can attempt to frighten other ships. Each crewmember deployed on a hostile ship must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} contested by a Charisma (Menace) check. On a failed save, affected crewmembers have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} they make each round for 1 minute. At the end of each of their turns, they repeat this save, ending this effect on a success. Additionally, on a successful save, they become immune to this feature for one day.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

optionalfeature.name: Versatile Dreadnought

entries.name: Availability
entries: Gargantuan starship, tier 3

Starting at 3rd tier, when a crewmember makes an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, they can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. A crewmember can choose to use this feature after they make their roll, but before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to 2 x your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

optionalfeature.name: Superweapon

entries.name: Availability
entries: Gargantuan starship, tier 3

Also at 3rd tier, your ship is equipped with a superweapon. As an action, a crewmember can activate the superweapon, which has a limited {@variantrule Firing Arc|sw5e-sotg|firing arc}, as described in Chapter 9. When activated, a beam of destructive energy forming a line 10,000 feet long and 100 feet wide blasts from the weapon. Each ship in the line must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + the crewmember's {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + the ship's Strength modifier). On a failed save, a ship takes 15d10 energy damage, or half as much on a successful one.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

optionalfeature.name: Role Mastery (Gargantuan)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Gargantuan starship, tier 4
At 4th tier, you master a particular style of design for your ship. Choose any one from the following.

entries.name: Blockade Ship
entries: Your ship's shield regeneration rate doubles.

entries.name: Flag Ship
entries: A crewmember deployed in a command center can, as an action, issue an order to a Huge or smaller ship. That ship can immediately move up to its flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and up to five crewmembers on that ship can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to immediately take an action.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: Industrial Center
entries: Your ship gains two Docking Bay suites at no cost, which do not count against its total suite systems. Additionally, the capacity of your docking bays are doubled.

entries.name: Mobile Metropolis
entries: Your ship's fuel capacity, as shown in the Starship Size Fuel Capacity table, and storage capacity, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Storage Capacity} table, doubles. Additionally, while traveling in realspace, your ship consumes half the amount of fuel as normal.

entries.name: Researcher
entries: When you use your ship's Superweapon, you can alter its functionality. Instead of dealing damage, ships who fail a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} are {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}, ionized, and {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} for 1 minute. Ships who succeed on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} suffer these effects until the start of your ship's next turn, instead.

entries.name: Warship
entries: When a crewmember on your ship rolls the maximum on a damage die for a ship weapon, they can roll an additional die.

optionalfeature.name: Citadel

entries.name: Availability
entries: Gargantuan starship, tier 4

Also at 4th tier, the capacity for all of your suites is doubled.  If a suite type's capacity was already doubled, its size is instead tripled from its standard size. Additionally, your starship's maximum capacity for fuel and consumables doubles, and civilians, crewmembers, and troopers aboard your starship have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb}.  If the capacity for fuel and/or consumables was already double its standard amount, it is now triple its original capacity.

optionalfeature.name: Paragon Dreadnought

entries.name: Availability
entries: Gargantuan starship, tier 5

As of 5th tier, your starship is the best in its class. Two of your ship's ability scores increase by 4, and its maximum for these scores increase by 4.  Another ability score increases by 2, and its maximum for this score increases by 2.

optionalfeature.name: Devastator

entries.name: Availability
entries: Gargantuan starship, tier 5
Also at 5th tier, as an action, a single crewmember can give the ship the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: Your ship has resistance to all damage.
Your ship's ship attacks score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-sotg|critical hit} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

entries: This effect ends early if the ship is disabled. Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship undergoes refitting.

optionalfeature.name: Damage Control

entries.name: Availability
entries: Huge starship, tier 1
Also at 1st tier, your starship gains the ability to automatically mitigate damage from ships.

Once per turn, as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg} to being dealt damage by a ship weapon, a crewmember can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and roll a Damage Control die, which is a {@dice d4}, and subtract it from the damage roll.
Your ship's Damage Control die changes when it reaches certain tiers. The die becomes a {@dice d6} at 2nd tier, a {@dice d8} at 3rd tier, a {@dice d10} at 4th tier, and a {@dice d12} at 5th tier.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to 4 x your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship undergoes refitting.

optionalfeature.name: Role Specialization (Huge)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Huge starship, tier 2
At 2nd tier, you adopt a particular style of design for your ship. Choose any one from the following.

entries.name: Battleship
entries: Your ship gains two Fixed Hardpoint modifications at no cost. Additionally, your ship has a +1 bonus to damage rolls with ship weapons.

entries.name: Carrier
entries: Your ship gains two Docking Bay suites at no cost. Additionally, the capacity of your docking bays are doubled.

entries.name: Colonizer
entries: Your ship gains two Barracks suites at no cost. Additionally, {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against poison and disease on your ship are made with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage}.

entries.name: Command Ship
entries: Your ship gains the Comms Package, Premium and Command Center suite modifications at no cost. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on Charisma (Impress) checks.

entries.name: Interdictor
entries: Your ship gains the Tractor Beam and Gravity Well Projector modifications at no cost. Additionally, ships of Huge size or smaller have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws} against your tractor beams.

entries.name: Juggernaut
entries: Your hull point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your number of hull dice. Whenever you gain a hull die thereafter, your hull point maximum increases by an additional 2 {@variantrule Hull Points|sw5e-sotg|hull points}.

optionalfeature.name: Staging Ground

entries.name: Availability
entries: Huge starship, tier 2

Also at 2nd tier, the capacity for your Barracks, Living Quarters, and Luxury Quarters suites are doubled. Additionally, when crewmembers or troopers deploy, they have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on their first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} they make before the end of their next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Once a crewmember or troop has benefited from this feature, they can not benefit from it again until they complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

optionalfeature.name: Versatile Cruiser

entries.name: Availability
entries: Huge starship, tier 3

Starting at 3rd tier, when a crewmember makes an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, they can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. A crewmember can choose to use this feature after they make their roll, but before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to 2 x your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship undergoes recharging.

optionalfeature.name: Capital Railgun

entries.name: Availability
entries: Huge starship, tier 3

Also at 3rd tier, your ship is equipped with a forward-mounted special version of a Heavy Slug Railgun at its helm.  Your ship is considered to meet this weapon's constitution requirement regardless of your ship's constitution ability score.  The damage dealt by this Heavy Slug Railgun is 7d12.
This weapon does not utilize or count as a weapon hardpoint.

optionalfeature.name: Role Mastery (Huge)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Huge starship, tier 4
At 4th tier, you master a particular style of design for your ship. Choose any one from the following.

entries.name: Battleship
entries: When a crewmember rolls a 1 or 2 on the on a damage die for a primary or secondary weapon, they can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.

entries.name: Carrier
entries: When ships are deployed from your carrier, they have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-sotg|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} they make before the end of their next refitting. Once a ship has benefited from this feature, it can not benefit from it again until it undergoes refitting.

entries.name: Colonizer
entries: Your ship's fuel capacity, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Fuel Capacity} table, doubles. Additionally, while traveling in realspace, your ship consumes half the amount of fuel.

entries.name: Command Ship
entries: Your ship gains the Comms Package, Premium, and Comms Package, Prototype modifications at no cost. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on Charisma (Menace) checks.

entries.name: Interdictor
entries: Ships of all sizes have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws} against your tractor beams. Additionally, you can force ships of Large size and smaller to reroll one of the dice once.

entries.name: Juggernaut
entries: When you deal damage on a ram, the damage you inflict on other ships increases by +2 per hull die of your ship.

optionalfeature.name: Broadside

entries.name: Availability
entries: Huge starship, tier 4

Also at 4th tier, once on each of their turns, when a crewmember makes a ship attack, they can make another attack with the same weapon against a different ship that is within 100 feet of the original target and within range of their weapon.

optionalfeature.name: Paragon Cruiser

entries.name: Availability
entries: Huge starship, tier 5

As of 5th tier, your starship is the best in its class. One of your ship's ability scores increases by 4, and its maximum for this score increase by 4.  Another two ability scores increase by 2, and its maximum for these scores increase by 2.

optionalfeature.name: Capital Ship

entries.name: Availability
entries: Huge starship, tier 5

Also at 5th tier, a crewmember can, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, delegate a plan of action to the crew. The ship can immediately move up to its flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and up to five crewmembers on that ship can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to immediately take an action.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

optionalfeature.name: Blockade Runner

entries.name: Availability
entries: Large starship, tier 1
Also at 1st tier, your starship gains the ability to react to damage from large ships.

As a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg} to being hit with an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll} from a Large or larger ship, a crewmember at the helm can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to immediately move the ship forward an amount equal to half its flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} (rounded down) and then roll a Blockade Runner die, which is a {@dice d4}, and subtract it from the triggering {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll}, potentially causing it to miss.
Your ship's Blockade Runner die changes when it reaches certain tiers. The die becomes a {@dice d6} at 2nd tier, a {@dice d8} at 3rd tier, a {@dice d10} at 4th tier, and a {@dice d12} at 5th tier.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to 3 x your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

optionalfeature.name: Role Specialization (Large)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Large starship, tier 2
At 2nd tier, you adopt a particular style of design for your ship. Choose from the following.

entries.name: Ambassador
entries: Your ship gains a Luxury Quarters suite at no cost. Additionally, while hosting guests on your ship, crewmembers have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Charisma checks made against them.

entries.name: Corvette
entries: Your ship gains a Fixed Hardpoint modification at no cost. Additionally, your ship has a +1 bonus to damage rolls with ship weapons.

entries.name: Cruiser
entries: Starships one or more sizes larger than you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws} against your tertiary and quaternary weapons.

entries.name: Explorer
entries: Your ship gains the Scanner, Premium modification at no cost. Additionally, the range of its scanners is increased by 1,000 feet.

entries.name: Picket Ship
entries: Your ship can install a single point-defense primary weapon in a hardpoint.  This hardpoint may be modified to include more than a single limited {@variantrule Firing Arc|sw5e-sotg|firing arc}.

entries.name: Ship's Tender
entries: Your ship gains a Fuel Storage modification at no cost.

optionalfeature.name: Concentrated Fire

entries.name: Availability
entries: Large starship, tier 2

Also at 2nd tier, once per turn, when you attack a ship of size Large or larger, and it was previously hit by an allied ship of size Large or larger's weapons since the end of its last turn, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the attack. If you already had {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage}, you may instead reroll one of the dice once (your choice).

optionalfeature.name: Versatile Frigate

entries.name: Availability
entries: Large starship, tier 3

Starting at 3rd tier, when a crewmember makes an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} with the ship, they can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. A crewmember can choose to use this feature after they make their roll, but before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to 3 x your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

optionalfeature.name: Super-Heavy Turbolaser Battery

entries.name: Availability
entries: Large starship, tier 3

Also at 3rd tier, your ship is equipped with a forward-mounted special version of a Turbolaser.  Your ship is considered to meet this weapon's constitution requirement regardless of your ship's constitution ability score.  The damage dealt by this Turbolaser is 3d12.
This weapon does not utilize or count as a weapon hardpoint.

optionalfeature.name: Role Mastery (Large)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Large starship, tier 4
At 4th tier, you master a particular style of design for your ship. Choose from the following.

entries.name: Ambassador
entries: Your ship has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws} to avoid being rammed or tractored.

entries.name: Corvette
entries: Your ship's flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

entries.name: Cruiser
entries: When firing a tertiary or quaternary weapon, you can load each weapon with multiple types of munitions up to your reload number and select which to fire when you take the attack action with that weapon.

entries.name: Explorer
entries: Your ship can detect ships moving through hyperspace with its scanners, and it ignores environmental effects that would impact its scanners.

entries.name: Picket Ship
entries: The close and long ranges of your point defense systems increase by 100 feet. Additionally, Large or smaller ships have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws} against your point defense systems.

entries.name: Ship's Tender
entries: Your ship gains the Nano-Droid Distributor modification at no cost. Additionally, the range of its effects is increased by 400 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Tactical Retreat

entries.name: Availability
entries: Large starship, tier 4

Also at 4th tier, when a crewmember rolls a 1 on an Intelligence (Astrogation) check to calculate astrogation, or a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain the hyperdrive booting, they can reroll the die. They must use the new roll.

optionalfeature.name: Paragon Frigate

entries.name: Availability
entries: Large starship, tier 5
As of 5th tier, your starship is the best in its class. Three of your ship's ability scores increase by 2. Its maximum for these scores increases by 2.

optionalfeature.name: Spinal Mount

entries.name: Availability
entries: Large starship, tier 5

Also at 5th tier, once on each crewmember's turn, they can add the ship's Strength modifier to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or the ship's Intelligence modifier to the damage roll of an attack it makes. You can choose to use this feature before or after the roll, but before any effects of the roll are applied.

optionalfeature.name: Evasive Maneuvers

entries.name: Availability
entries: Medium starship, tier 1

Also at 1st tier, when a crewmember at the helm rolls for {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}, they can immediately move the ship. This movement happens before the {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} order is determined.

The amount the ship moves is determined by rolling an Evasive Maneuvers die, which is a {@dice d4}, and multiplying it by 50 feet. The ship then gains that many feet that it can move or spend to turn.
Your ship's Evasive Maneuvers die changes when it reaches certain tiers. The die becomes a {@dice d6} at 2nd tier, a {@dice d8} at 3rd tier, a {@dice d10} at 4th tier, and a {@dice d12} at 5th tier.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to 2x your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

optionalfeature.name: Role Specialization (Medium)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Medium starship, tier 2
At 2nd tier, you adopt a particular style of design for your ship. Choose any one from the following.

entries.name: Courier
entries: Your ship's flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

entries.name: Freighter
entries: Your ship gains the Storage Compartment modification at no cost. Additionally, your ship's base cargo capacity increases to 50 tons.

entries.name: Gunship
entries: Your ship gains a Fixed Hardpoint modification at no cost. Additionally, your ship has a +1 bonus to damage rolls with ship weapons.

entries.name: Missile Boat
entries: Starships one or more sizes larger than you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws} against your tertiary and quaternary weapons.

entries.name: Navigator
entries: Your ship gains the Navcomputer modification at no cost. Additionally, if a crewmember must roll on the {@b Hyperspace Mishaps} table, they can roll twice and choose either total.

entries.name: Yacht
entries: Your ship gains the Recreation modification at no cost. Additionally, while hosting guests on your ship, they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on Intelligence and Wisdom checks.

optionalfeature.name: Nimble Starship

entries.name: Availability
entries: Medium starship, tier 2
Also at 2nd tier, your ship can add half its Dexterity modifier (minimum of one) to any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} it makes that doesn't already include that modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Versatile Transport

entries.name: Availability
entries: Medium starship, tier 3

Starting at 3rd tier, when a crewmember makes, with the ship, an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, they can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. A crewmember can choose to use this feature after they make their roll, but before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to 2x your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

optionalfeature.name: Hold Together

entries.name: Availability
entries: Medium starship, tier 3

Also at 3rd tier, when your ship takes damage while at 0 {@variantrule Hull Points|sw5e-sotg|hull points}, it makes a {@variantrule Destruction Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, instead of automatically failing.

optionalfeature.name: Role Mastery (Medium)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Medium starship, tier 4
At 4th tier, you master a particular style of design for your ship. Choose any one from the following.

entries.name: Courier
entries: Your ship gains the Backup Hyperdrive modification at no cost.  Any installed hyperdrive operates as one of the next faster class.  If you have a class 0.5 hyperdrive installed, it acts as a 0.4 hyperdrive.

entries.name: Freighter
entries: When your ship fails a Strength or Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, a crewmember can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to jettison some of the cargo stored in its storage compartments. If you jettison at least 50 tons of cargo, you can reroll the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} and must use the new roll. If you jettison at least 75 tons of cargo, however, you instead automatically succeed on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. Additionally, the area in a line 300 feet long and 100 feet wide behind your ship becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-sotg|difficult terrain} for 1 minute.

entries.name: Gunship
entries: Once per round, a crewmember can roll the weapon damage dice one additional time when determining the extra damage for a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-sotg|critical hit} with a ship attack.

entries.name: Missile Boat
entries: When firing a tertiary or quaternary weapon, you can load each weapon with multiple types of munitions up to your reload number and select which to fire when you take the attack action with that weapon.

entries.name: Navigator
entries: Your ship has resistance to damage from environmental effects, and {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws} to resist the effects of environmental effects.

entries.name: Yacht
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} Charisma checks made against those who can see your ship.

optionalfeature.name: Adaptive Armor

entries.name: Availability
entries: Medium starship, tier 4

Also at 4th tier, when your ship is hit with an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll}, a crewmember at the helm can add the ship's Constitution modifier to AC, potentially causing the attack to miss.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

optionalfeature.name: Paragon Transport

entries.name: Availability
entries: Medium starship, tier 5
As of 5th tier, your starship is the best in its class.  Two of your ship's ability scores increase by 2.  It's maximums for these scores increase by two.

optionalfeature.name: Best Ship in the 'Verse

entries.name: Availability
entries: Medium starship, tier 5
Also at 5th tier, as an action, a crewmember can give the ship resistance to unenhanced damage from ship weapons for 1 minute.
This effect ends early if the ship is disabled. Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

optionalfeature.name: Pinpoint Strike

entries.name: Availability
entries: Small starship, tier 1
Also at 1st tier, your starship gains the ability to slip underneath the shields of an enemy ship.

When your ship occupies the same square occupied by a target ship and the crewmember at the helm makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}, they can, before rolling the attack, roll a Pinpoint Strike die, which is a {@dice d4}, and add it to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll}.  If the attack requires a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} instead, you may subtract the Pinpoint Strike die from the target's save result.  On a hit or a failed save, the attack deals normal damage that bypasses any shields and directly hits the hull of the target ship. This feature can only be used once per round.
Your ship's Pinpoint Strike die changes when it reaches certain tiers. The die becomes a {@dice d6} at 2nd tier, a {@dice d8} at 3rd tier, a {@dice d10} at 4th tier, and a {@dice d12} at 5th tier.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

optionalfeature.name: Role Specialization (Small)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Small starship, tier 2
At 2nd tier, you adopt a particular style of design for your ship. Choose any one from the following.

entries.name: Attack Fighter
entries: Your ship gains a +1 bonus to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack rolls} and save DCs of its ship weapons.

entries.name: Bomber
entries: Your ship gains a +1 bonus to damage rolls with ship weapons.

entries.name: Scout
entries: Your ship gains a +1 bonus to Wisdom (Scan) and Intelligence (Probe) checks.

entries.name: Scrambler
entries: Your ship's crew can use interfere as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg}.

entries.name: Shuttle
entries: Your ship gains or replaces one suite system of your choice at no cost, but it does count against your maximum suites. Your Starship Size Suite Capacity for this suite is 2.  Your maximum suites is a minimum of 1.

entries.name: Superiority Fighter
entries: Your ship's flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Retro Thrusters

entries.name: Availability
entries: Small starship, tier 2

Also at 2nd tier, when an attacker that a crewmember can see deals damage to your ship with a weapon, they can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to immediately move the ship up to 50 feet in a direction of their choice, halving the damage your ship takes. The orientation of the ship does not change.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

optionalfeature.name: Versatile Snubfighter

entries.name: Availability
entries: Small starship, tier 3

Starting at 3rd tier, when a crewmember makes, with the ship, an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, they can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. A crewmember can choose to use this feature after they make their roll, but before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

optionalfeature.name: Auto-Thrusters

entries.name: Availability
entries: Small starship, tier 3
Also at 3rd tier, your ship can add half of its Strength modifier (rounded down, minimum of one) to its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}.

optionalfeature.name: Role Mastery (Small)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Small starship, tier 4
At 4th tier, you master a particular style of design for your ship. Choose any one from the following.

entries.name: Attack Fighter
entries: Your ship's shield regeneration rate is doubled.

entries.name: Bomber
entries: Starships one or more sizes larger than you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws} against your tertiary and quaternary weapons.

entries.name: Scout
entries: Your ship gains a +2 bonus to Intelligence (Astrogation) checks and enemy ships have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on Wisdom (scan) checks to detect your ship entering and exiting hyperspace.

entries.name: Scrambler
entries: Your ship gains a +2 bonus to Charisma (Interfere) checks.

entries.name: Shuttle
entries: Your ship gains or replaces one suite system of your choice at no cost, but it does count against your maximum suites. Your Starship Size Suite Capacity for this suite is 2.  Your maximum suites is a minimum of 2.

entries.name: Superiority Fighter
entries: Your ship's turning {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} decreases by 50 feet. If this would decrease your ship's turning {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} to 0, instead your ship's flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Standing By

entries.name: Availability
entries: Small starship, tier 4

Also at 4th tier, your ship can be pushed beyond its normal limits for a moment. On their turn, a crewmember can take one additional action on top of their regular action and a possible {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

optionalfeature.name: Paragon Snubfighter

entries.name: Availability
entries: Small starship, tier 5
As of 5th tier, your starship is the best in its class. Choose any one from the following:

entries.name: Attack Fighter
entries: Your ship's Strength score increases by 2.  It's maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Bomber
entries: Your ship's Wisdom score increases by 2.  It's maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Scout
entries: Your ship's Intelligence score increases by 2.  It's maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Scrambler
entries: Your ship's Charisma score increases by 2.  It's maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Shuttle
entries: Your ship's Constitution score increases by 2.  It's maximum for this score increases by 2..

entries.name: Superiority Fighter
entries: Your ship's Dexterity score increases by 2.  It's maximum for this score increases by 2.

optionalfeature.name: A Leaf on the Wind

entries.name: Availability
entries: Small starship, tier 5

Also at 5th tier, when a crewmember, makes, with the ship, an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the crewmember can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to treat the amount rolled on the {@dice d20} as a 20.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

optionalfeature.name: Swarm Tactics

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship, tier 1
Also at 1st tier, your starship is most effective when working in groups.

Your ship makes the most of every opportunity provided by allies. When a crewmember at the helm would make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against a larger ship, and there is an allied ship within 200 feet of your target, they can roll a Swarm Tactics die, which is a {@dice d4}, and add it to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll}. You can do this after the roll is made, but before the result is known.
Your ship's Swarm Tactics die changes when it reaches certain tiers. The die becomes a {@dice d6} at 2nd tier, a {@dice d8} at 3rd tier, a {@dice d10} at 4th tier and a {@dice d12} at 5th tier.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to 2 x your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

optionalfeature.name: Role Specialization (Tiny)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship, tier 2
At 2nd tier, you adopt a particular style of design for your ship. Choose any one from the following:

entries.name: Droid
entries: Your ship gains the Droid Brain, Makeshift and Droid Brain, Mk I modifications at no cost.
Additionally, on your ship's turn, it can take one additional action on top of its regular actions.  Once this feature has been used, your ship must recharge before it can use it again.

entries.name: Munition
entries: Your ship gains the Hardened Prow modification at no cost.
Additionally, when you deal damage on a ram, the damage you inflict on other ships increases by +2 per hull die of your ship.

entries.name: Predator
entries: Once per turn, your ship can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one ship it hits with a primary weapon if your ship has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll}. This damage is the same as the weapon’s damage, and the attack must use a weapon without a constitution requirement.

Your ship doesn’t need {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll} if another enemy of the target is within 50 feet of it, that enemy isn’t disabled, and your ship doesn’t have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll}

entries.name: Probe
entries: Your ship gains the Scanner, Mk I modification at no cost.

Additionally, when your ship attacks a ship or creature it can’t see, its inability to see it doesn’t impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on its {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack rolls} against it.

entries.name: Satellite
entries: Your ship gains the Comms Package, Mk I modification at no cost.
Additionally, you can take the {@action Interfere|sw5e-sotg} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg}.

entries.name: Worker
entries: Your ship gains the Tractor Beam modification at no cost.
Additionally, your ship is treated as a medium ship for purposes of this modification.

optionalfeature.name: Nimble Aerobatics

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship, tier 2

Also at 2nd tier, your ship is so nimble that it can ignore unenhanced {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-sotg|difficult terrain}, and when it you would use an action to break free of an effect that is tractoring or otherwise restraining your ship, you can instead use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg}.

optionalfeature.name: Uncanny Dodge

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship, tier 3

At 3rd tier, your ship's agility lets it dodge out of the way of certain area effects. When your ship is subjected to an effect, such as a proton torpedo or a seismic charge, that allows your ship to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, and only half damage if it fails.

optionalfeature.name: Swarm Defense

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship, tier 3

Also at 3rd tier, your ship further benefits from being surrounded by allies. Your ship gains a bonus its to AC equal to number of allied ships within 100 feet of it. The bonus has a maximum value equal to your ship's tier (rounded up).

optionalfeature.name: Role Mastery (Tiny)

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship, tier 4
At 4th tier, you master a particular style of design for your ship. Choose any one from the following.

entries.name: Droid
entries: Your ship gains the Droid Brain, Mk II modification at no cost.
Additionally, your ship can take a second {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg} each round. It can only take one {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg} per turn.

entries.name: Munition
entries: Your ship gains the Self-Destruct Mechanism modification at no cost.
Additionally, when you deal damage upon self-destruction, the damage you inflict on other ships increases by +2 per hull die of your ship.

entries.name: Predator
entries: Your ship deals 1d6 additional damage when it scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-sotg|critical hit} with an attack.

entries.name: Probe
entries: Your ship gains the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} Device modification at no cost.

Additionally, when your ship attempts to conceal on its turn, it can opt to not move on that turn causing creatures that attempt to detect your ship to take a -10 penalty to their Wisdom (Scan) checks until the start of your ship's next turn. Your ship loses this benefit if it moves, either voluntarily or because of some external effect.

entries.name: Satellite
entries: Your ship gains the Electromagnetic Scrambler, Mk I and Electromagnetic Scrambler, Mk II modifications at no cost.
Additionally, the range of these modifications is 1200 feet.

entries.name: Worker
entries: Your ship gains the Tractor Beam Heavy Capacitors modification at no cost.
Additionally, your ship is treated as a medium ship for purposes of this modification.

optionalfeature.name: Elusive Target

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship, tier 4

Also at 4th tier, the size and agility of your ship makes it easy to avoid attacks. No primary weapon attacks made against your ship can benefit from {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} while your ship is not disabled.

optionalfeature.name: Paragon Swarmer

entries: Tiny starship, tier 5

entries.name: Droid
entries: Your ship’s Intelligence score increases by 2. It’s maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Munition
entries: Your ship’s Constitution score increases by 2. It’s maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Predator
entries: Your ship’s Dexterity score increases by 2. It’s maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Probe
entries: Your ship’s Wisdom score increases by 2. It’s maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Satellite
entries: Your ship’s Charisma score increases by 2. It’s maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Worker
entries: Your ship’s Strength score increases by 2. It’s maximum for this score increases by 2.

optionalfeature.name: Keen Accuracy

If the damage reduces your ship's shields to 0, the protected ship takes any remaining damage.

That ship can immediately move up to its flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and up to five crewmembers on that ship can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to immediately take an action.

entries: Small starship

entries.name: Role Specialization (2nd tier)
entries: Your ship gains or replaces one suite system of your choice at no cost, but it does count against your maximum suites. Your Starship Size Suite Capacity for this suite is 2.  Your maximum suites is a minimum of 1.

entries.name: Role Mastery (4th tier)
entries: Your ship gains or replaces one suite system of your choice at no cost, but it does count against your maximum suites. Your Starship Size Suite Capacity for this suite is 2.  Your maximum suites is a minimum of 2.

entries.name: Availability
entries: Small starship

entries.name: Role Specialization (2nd tier)
entries: Your ship's flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

entries.name: Role Mastery (4th tier)
entries: Your ship's turning {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} decreases by 50 feet. If this would decrease your ship's turning {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} to 0, instead your ship's flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship

entries.name: Role Specialization (2nd tier)
entries: Your ship gains the Droid Brain, Makeshift and Droid Brain, Mk I modifications at no cost.
Additionally, on your ship's turn, it can take one additional action on top of its regular actions.  Once this feature has been used, your ship must recharge before it can use it again.

entries.name: Role Mastery (4th tier)
entries: Your ship gains the Droid Brain, Mk II modification at no cost.
Additionally, your ship can take a second {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg} each round. It can only take one {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg} per turn.

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship

entries.name: Role Specialization (2nd tier)
entries: Your ship gains the Hardened Prow modification at no cost.
Additionally, when you deal damage on a ram, the damage you inflict on other ships increases by +2 per hull die of your ship.

entries.name: Role Mastery (4th tier)
entries: Your ship gains the Self-Destruct Mechanism modification at no cost.
Additionally, when you deal damage upon self-destruction, the damage you inflict on other ships increases by +2 per hull die of your ship.

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship

entries.name: Role Specialization (2nd tier)
entries: Once per turn, your ship can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one ship it hits with a primary weapon if your ship has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll}. This damage is the same as the weapon’s damage, and the attack must use a weapon without a constitution requirement.

Your ship doesn’t need {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll} if another enemy of the target is within 50 feet of it, that enemy isn’t disabled, and your ship doesn’t have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll}

entries.name: Role Mastery (4th tier)
entries: Your ship deals 1d6 additional damage when it scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-sotg|critical hit} with an attack.

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship

entries.name: Role Specialization (2nd tier)
entries: Your ship gains the Scanner, Mk I modification at no cost.

Additionally, when your ship attacks a ship or creature it can’t see, its inability to see it doesn’t impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on its {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack rolls} against it.

entries.name: Role Mastery (4th tier)
entries: Your ship gains the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} Device modification at no cost.

Additionally, when your ship attempts to conceal on its turn, it can opt to not move on that turn causing creatures that attempt to detect your ship to take a -10 penalty to their Wisdom (Scan) checks until the start of your ship's next turn. Your ship loses this benefit if it moves, either voluntarily or because of some external effect.

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship

entries.name: Role Specialization (2nd tier)
entries: Your ship gains the Comms Package, Mk I modification at no cost.
Additionally, you can take the {@action Interfere|sw5e-sotg} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg}.

entries.name: Role Mastery (4th tier)
entries: Your ship gains the Electromagnetic Scrambler, Mk I and Electromagnetic Scrambler, Mk II modifications at no cost.
Additionally, the range of these modifications is 1200 feet.

entries.name: Availability
entries: Tiny starship

entries.name: Role Specialization (2nd tier)
entries: Your ship gains the Tractor Beam modification at no cost.
Additionally, your ship is treated as a medium ship for purposes of this modification.

entries.name: Role Mastery (4th tier)
entries: Your ship gains the Tractor Beam Heavy Capacitors modification at no cost.
Additionally, your ship is treated as a medium ship for purposes of this modification.
